test_modes.name: DCP flashing
test_modes.purpose: Physically identify a station found via DCP.

test_modes.name: Topology check
test_modes.purpose: Compare LLDP-discovered topology to the planned topology (IRT requirement).

spec_provided_observability.name: DCP Identify / Signal
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Discover stations and physically locate one (flashing LED) for commissioning/debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: LLDP topology
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-port neighbor/chassis/port IDs (EtherType 0x88CC) build the physical topology and detect cable swaps (CC-B+).

spec_provided_observability.name: SNMP diagnosis
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Network-level diagnosis/MIB access for the engineering tool (CC-B+).

spec_provided_observability.name: Channel / submodule / module diagnosis
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read diagnosis records (ChannelErrorType, ChannelNumber, severity) acyclically and via the Alarm-CR.

spec_provided_observability.name: APDU Cycle Counter / Data Status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-frame liveness, DataValid, Provider State (Run/Stop), and Station Problem Indicator for run-time health.

spec_provided_observability.name: I&M records
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Standardized identification & maintenance data (I&M0..I&M4) for asset management.

error_detection_mechanisms: APDU Cycle Counter detects missed/duplicated/late cyclic frames.
Watchdog (data-hold) timeout detects loss of cyclic data.
Per-object IOPS/IOCS signal partial data invalidity.
Configuration mismatch (Module/Submodule Ident) detected at Connect / by diagnosis.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: watchdog miss / CL-RPC abort / fatal diagnosis.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: PROFINET's observability is built around DCP (discovery/location), LLDP/SNMP (topology/diagnosis, CC-B+), the per-frame APDU status/IOPS/IOCS, and the acyclic diagnosis/I&M records plus the Alarm-CR. Conformance is established by the PI certification per conformance class.
